info.title: say API
info.summary: HTTP API currently implemented by say
info.description: Comprehensive OpenAPI 3.1.0 specification for say: a play-money binary prediction exchange. Covers all endpoints for authentication, account settings & staff role management, seasons, ledger & balances, market registry & categories, matching engine & orders, portfolio positions & settled results, notifications & preferences, resolution queue, evidence collection, disputes & final settlement, treasury reserves & automated bot fleet management, season leaderboard rankings & strip, public user profiles, governance approvals inbox, structured audit log queries & exports, and real-time WebSocket stream. Authenticate using the `say_session` cookie (browser) or Authorization Bearer token (mobile/API). Staff administrative routes enforce role-based authorization and 2-person approval safeguards where applicable.
